import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

theorem quadratic_finset_offset_mod_residue (S : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) (h₀ : ∀ x, x ∈ S ↔ 0 < x ∧ x ^ 2 + 4 * x + 4 < 20) (h₁ : 2 * n ≡ 15 + S.card [MOD 47]) : n ≡ 32 [MOD 47] := by
  have hS_eq : S = ({1, 2} : Finset ℕ) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hmem := (h₀ x).mp hx
      have h_le : x ≤ 2 := by nlinarith [hmem.2]
      interval_cases x
      · omega
      · left; rfl
      · right; rfl
    · intro hx
      apply (h₀ x).mpr
      rcases hx with rfl | rfl
      · decide
      · decide
  have hcard : S.card = 2 := by
    rw [hS_eq]
    decide
  have h1' : 2 * n ≡ 17 [MOD 47] := by
    simpa [hcard] using h₁
  -- Convert ModEq to equality of remainders
  have h_mod : (2 * n) % 47 = 17 % 47 := h1'
  have h17mod : (17 : ℕ) % 47 = 17 := by decide
  rw [h17mod] at h_mod
  -- (2 * n) % 47 = (2 * (n % 47)) % 47
  have h_mul_mod : (2 * n) % 47 = (2 * (n % 47)) % 47 := by
    have h1 : (2 * n) % 47 = ((2 % 47) * (n % 47)) % 47 := by
      rw [Nat.mul_mod]
    have h2 : (2 : ℕ) % 47 = 2 := by decide
    rw [h1, h2]
  have h_mod_r : (2 * (n % 47)) % 47 = 17 := by
    rw [← h_mul_mod]
    exact h_mod
  have h_lt : n % 47 < 47 := Nat.mod_lt n (by decide)
  -- Exhaustive check on the remainder: only 32 satisfies 2*r %47 =17
  have h_forall : ∀ r, r < 47 → (2 * r) % 47 = 17 → r = 32 := by
    native_decide
  have h_r_eq : n % 47 = 32 := h_forall _ h_lt h_mod_r
  rw [Nat.ModEq]
  have h32mod : (32 : ℕ) % 47 = 32 := by decide
  rw [h32mod]
  exact h_r_eq
